$comment: Borrowed from deepseek-harness's 'everything is a plugin': there is no
privileged main line of investigation. A thread mounts beside the others,
runs independently, and unwinds cleanly if abandoned. Threads may fork
from a parent and may converge back into one.
Git branches carry the CODE. This registry carries the ARGUMENT: what was
believed, what would falsify it, and what actually happened. Branches get
status:  proposed | active | parked | converged | abandoned
An abandoned thread is a RESULT, not a failure, and keeps its verdict.
Deleting dead threads is how a research log turns into marketing.

threads.hypothesis: EML primitives can be implemented safely enough to iterate thousands of times
threads.falsifier: no stabilised variant survives 5k iterations without NaN
threads.verdict: supported: eml_stable survives 5k steps x 256 starts

threads.hypothesis: An EML/SOL forest can recover the uv^2 cross term of Gray-Scott
threads.falsifier: extrapolation ratio > 10x OR error > 1e6x the exact-basis control
threads.verdict: FALSIFIED 2026-08-20: EML/SOL approximates (relMSE 1.1e-2) but does not recover; 2.27e29x worse than exact basis. Given a mixed basis the search selects the polynomial u*v^2. Confirms Asanuma on cross-variable interaction.
threads.notes: Deliberately targets EML's known weakness. Asanuma reports the univariate-additive form cannot represent cross-variable interaction. A clean negative here is a valid and useful outcome.

threads.hypothesis: Erez's 3-param gate can replace Lenia's Gaussian growth function and sustain Orbium
threads.falsifier: Orbium dies before 1000 steps for all (a,b,c) in the swept range
threads.notes: Highest prior probability. Lenia's growth function is univariate and non-monotone, which is exactly the shape Erez's gate produces natively in one block.

threads.hypothesis: An EML forest with a linear perception projection matches Growing-NCA at <= 300 params vs ~8000
threads.falsifier: no configuration under 300 params reaches comparable morphogenesis
threads.notes: Keep the linear projection: linear algebra mixes 48 dims well, EML does not. Belaiche and Asanuma converged on this fix independently.

threads.hypothesis: rho(J) from the analytic Jacobian predicts which NCA patterns persist
threads.falsifier: rho(J) shows no correlation with observed pattern survival
threads.notes: The genuinely novel angle. Currently unanswerable analytically for MLP-based NCA because the function is non-identifiable from the weights.

threads.hypothesis: Trained EML weights snap to exact symbolic values, recovering a readable rule
threads.falsifier: fewer than 10% of parameters snap within 30% loss tolerance
threads.notes: PRIOR IS LOW. Germany et al. report 0/42 at depth 3 on simpler targets. Registered anyway because it is EML's headline claim and a negative result here is worth publishing.
